articles.title: The Ancient Beat in Your Giggle: What Laughter Reveals About Speech
articles.summary: Your laugh carries a 15-million-year-old secret. Researchers found that all great apes share the same rhythmic pattern in their laughter—a crucial clue to how humans evolved the vocal control needed for speech.

articles.title: From Ocean Trash to Highway: Hawaii’s Bold Experiment with Plastic Roads
articles.summary: Hawaii is turning marine debris into pavement. Researchers mixed recycled fishing nets and household plastic into asphalt, and early tests show the roads perform well without shedding extra microplastics.

articles.title: A 13-Billion-Year-Old Sparkler: Hubble Captures Ancient Star Cluster for July 4th
articles.summary: NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope imaged globular cluster NGC 6426, a 13-billion-year-old swarm of stars. The red, white, and blue hues reveal a stellar time capsule from the early universe.
